title: Thuy An | Illustrator & UI Designer
description: Portfolio of Thuy An – illustrator and UI/UX designer based in Fukuoka, Japan.
heading: Thuy An – Illustrator & UI Designer
heroLabel: Bookshelf – pick a book to explore
about: Hi, I’m Thuy An, an illustrator and UI designer from Vietnam, currently based in Fukuoka, Japan. I graduated from Hanoi University of Industrial Fine Arts and later came to Japan to study at YMCA Language School. I’ve spent the past six years working in illustration and book cover design, and more recently, I’ve been diving into UI design as well. I love turning ideas into visuals, whether they’re drawings, stories, or digital experiences. It’s lovely to meet you!
illustrationIntro: I have around 8 years of experience in illustration, including the opportunity to work with publishers in Vietnam. I have also independently published my own book. I would be extremely grateful if everyone enjoys it!
uiIntro: I have approximately 3 years of experience in UI design, including the opportunity to work with TikTok, small-scale brands, and within a Japanese company. My experience involves direct client interaction and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
contact:
Hi, I’m Thuy An, an illustrator and UI designer who loves drawing, designing, and turning ideas into things people can enjoy. I’m always curious, always making, and always looking for a new story to tell.

Let’s make something good together. Have an idea? I’d love to hear from you!
